description: Updates an existing career journal entry. Only the fields provided will be changed — all other fields remain as-is. Use this to refine descriptions, add missing numbers to the metrics field, correct the entry date, or re-type an entry. This is the right tool to backfill quantification on entries saved without a full three-number breakdown (scale of action, direct result, organizational impact).

experience_id.description: Updated experience (role) ID to attach this entry to.

metrics.description: Updated quantifiable impact using the three-number rule: (1) scale of action, (2) direct result, (3) organizational impact. Use this to backfill missing numbers on entries that were saved without them.

type.description: Updated type: 1=achievement, 2=project, 3=skill_acquired, 4=reflection. Pass an integer or the label string.

uuid.description: UUID of the career entry to update. Returned by add_career_entry or list_career_entries.

name: update_career_entry
